items.title: Bloom Energy (BE) Stock Could Be Overvalued On Fresh AI Power News
items.summary: Bloom Energy has ridden a powerful three year share price surge, while its role in supplying power to energy hungry AI data centers has pushed it further into the spotlight. With the stock now reflecting both that long runup and fresh expectations, the open question is whether the current price lines up with what its earnings can reasonably support. Over the past three years, Bloom Energy has delivered a very large share price gain, which puts a lot of weight on the earnings story to carry...
